programme.title: Archiwalne finały Pucharu UEFA: FC Liverpool – Deportivo Alaves (2001)
programme.desc: FC Liverpool – Deportivo Alaves (2001) episode. A program that briefly presents the UEFA Cup finals, from the time when the two-legged final was replaced by one match in 1998, until the competition was transformed into the Europa League in the 2008/09 season. During this time, the games slowly changed their form. From the 1999/2000 season, teams that took third place in the Champions League group stage joined the competition. In the 2004/05 season, the cup system was changed to a group-cup system. There were qualifying rounds and the first round in a two-legged format. In the second round, the teams were divided into groups of five, but they played only one match against each other. 24 teams advanced to the third round, joined by eight teams from the third places of the Champions League group stage. From the third round, a two-legged system was used until the final, which was played as one match from 1998.

In the second round of the 2025/26 campaign, Portowcy will be tested by Motor Lublin. The ambitions of the Yellow-White-Blue are much higher than their seventh place at the end of the previous competition. Motor, on the other hand, wants to show that he has established himself among the elite and poses a real threat to the league leaders. programme.title: I, the captain – Jakub Czerwiński | E07
programme.desc: Eight profiles of captains of clubs playing in the PKO Bank Polski Ekstraklasa. These are the top players on their teams. They are at different stages of their careers, have different personalities, life principles and stories, but they are united by their love for football and the desire to win. These are eight great leaders. This time we will meet the mainstay of Piast Gliwice's defense, Jakub Czerwiński. The 32-year-old has a menacing appearance, but is calm and hard-working. He values ​​professionalism and draws strength from his family and religion. Czerwiński won the Polish championship three times in his football career. He dreams of further successes with the Piast team. Poland. 2024. documentary series

programme.title: Football: Ekstraklasa: Pogoń Szczecin – Motor Lublin
programme.desc: In recent years, the Port team came close to winning the Polish Cup and winning the Ekstraklasa podium. Robert Kolendowicz, Pogoń's coach, assures that the failures have not hampered the team. In his opinion, the Pride of Pomerania is much more hungry for success than its most dangerous rivals in the country. This is reflected in the movements of Szczecin's players on the transfer market. In the ongoing window, the Navy and Burgundy squad was strengthened by, among others: midfielder José Pozo from Śląsk and Paul Mukairu - former winger of FC Copenhagen. From Pogoń's perspective, however, the key factor may be the fact that despite interest from foreign clubs, Efthymios Koulouris, who scored 28 goals in the last Ekstraklasa season, will not leave the team. In the second round of the 2025/26 campaign, Portowcy will be tested by Motor Lublin. The ambitions of the Yellow-White-Blue are much higher than their seventh place at the end of the previous competition. Motor, on the other hand, wants to show that he has established himself among the elite and poses a real threat to the league leaders. We'll see if he will make a comeback from the match from November last year, when he defeated Pogoń 4:2

programme.title: Nile: the final river – Mountains of the Moon | E01
programme.desc: Researchers present extraordinary places located in the Nile Delta. They visit, among others: Lake Victoria and the Semien Mountains to look at the local fauna and flora. Documentarians go on a journey through areas related to the Upper Nile. They present the flora of the Rwenzori mountain range and observe the yellow-sided nectaries living in this region. They also visit the Nyungwe Forest National Park, which is inhabited by numerous representatives of primates, including: chimpanzees and Angolan gerees. They also stop at Lake Victoria to capture the extraordinary chironomid mating dance. Austria. 2014. documentary film

programme.title: Africa: hot life – Leopard, sand and heat | E02
programme.desc: Almost all wild inhabitants of hot regions of the world, such as Africa, are at risk of extinction due to climate change. The authors wonder whether and to what extent they will be able to adapt to new, difficult living conditions. Leopards live in thousands of ecosystems, from the rainforests of India to the driest regions of Africa; they adapt to almost any climate, feeding on over 100 different species. Great Britain. 2022. documentary series

programme.desc: Stories of people who encountered and recorded the most dangerous weather phenomena. Each episode presents blood-curdling footage from witnesses who survived fires, floods, tsunamis, hurricanes, avalanches, snowstorms and maritime disasters. There will also be reports from rescue operations. The city of Tuscaloosa, Alabama, is destroyed by a tornado. A group of students is dangerously close to him. Meanwhile, employees of the overcrowded city hospital have their hands full. Great Britain. 2018. documentary series

programme.desc: Animals must have a variety of tactics prepared to survive in one of the coldest places on our planet. From finding a convenient place to hunt to a shelter where they can raise their offspring. Nature film presenter Liz Bonnin will show viewers how animals cope in such difficult conditions... Great Britain. 2019. documentary film

programme.title: Secrets of water lands – Coasts | S01E02
programme.desc: The authors invite viewers on underwater journeys through oceans, swamps and other water areas from various parts of the world. In each episode, they show the richness of the ecosystems they visit, presenting the complex relationships between the organisms inhabiting them. Filmmakers travel along the coast, at the junction of several ecosystems. They observe hunting killer whales, the first jumps of guillemot hatchlings and the journey of young turtles to safe shelters. They also admire crabs carving sand galaxies. Great Britain. 2025. nature series

programme.title: In the Depths: North America – Northern Shores | S01E01
programme.desc: Filmmakers observe distant corners of the North American continent. In each episode they go to a different part of this land. With a camera, they observe the life of animals from various local ecosystems, from coastal waters to the air. Filmmakers observe distant corners of the North American continent. This time they will learn about the wild nature of Alaska, the Arctic and local representatives of fauna. Viewers will see, among others: a meal of polar bears and a hunt of bald eagles. USA. 2024. documentary series

programme.title: In the Depths: North America - Wild West | S01E02
programme.desc: Filmmakers observe distant corners of the North American continent. In each episode they go to a different part of this land. With a camera, they observe the life of animals from various local ecosystems, from coastal waters to the air. Filmmakers traverse the western coast of the continent. They explore the Canadian rainforests, admire the lush redwoods and explore the underwater environment of veritable kelp forests. They track wolves and bears and salmon migrating to spawn. USA. 2024. documentary series

programme.title: Atlantic – the wildest ocean – Life-giving current | E01
programme.desc: Narrator Cillian Murphy reveals the incredible, surprising and resilient inhabitants of the Atlantic - both animal and human. Every day they face the wildest ocean in the world. Viewers will learn how much influence the Gulf Stream has on life in the waters of the North Atlantic. It measures approximately 8,000 kilometers and is 100 times stronger than any river. Great Britain. 2015. documentary film

programme.title: Underwater City – Spring | S01E01
programme.desc: The Great Barrier Reef ecosystem is a unique and biologically diverse area, one of the largest structures of this type in the world. Like a bustling city, the reef harbors many distinct neighborhoods inhabited by coral and other animals, including lagoons, sandy islands and coastal rainforests. Each of these places has a unique rhythm of life, depending on the tides and times of day, as well as the variability of the seasons. Beneath the surface of the ocean and on its shores there is an ecosystem resembling a bustling city, full of migrants and natives. Filmmakers observe, among others: a green turtle looking for a mate. The cassowary takes care of the chicks. Australia. 2024. nature series

programme.desc: «90 years of LaLiga (2019): Andoni Zubizarreta» Andoni Zubizarreta developed his professional career at Deportivo Alavés, Athletic Club, FCBarcelona and Valencia. Representative of the great school of Basque goalkeepers, he is the footballer with the most games played in the history of the First Division. He played 622 games and all of them as a starter between 1981 and 1988. He was part of the golden era of Johan Cruyff's so-called Dream Team, winning the first European Cup in the history of the Catalan club. In 1994 and with his sixth league championship title, he left the Barcelona team to play for Valencia CF. Natural, sober, respectful and professional leader, Andoni Zubizarreta has been one of the best goalkeepers in the Spanish championship and is also still first in the classification of minutes played

Spiders use the trees' giant buttress roots as anchor points for their webs, ensnaring much of their prey at night. And owl monkeys, the world's only nocturnal monkey, search for insects. programme.title: d/s Underwater Universe. Branded seas
programme.desc: Marine life, under threat from human activity, needs protection more than ever. The series showcases the diversity of ocean ecosystems and explains what steps we must take to preserve them for future generations. We'll delve into the hidden lives of sea creatures, which include many unique species that remain beyond our reach, and show how important these ecosystems are to all life on the planet. Director: Miguel Angel Coba. UK, 2018

programme.title: d/f Adventures of cuttlefish
programme.desc: Dive into the underwater world of Brittany, where the odyssey of a young cuttlefish named Sepia begins! Every day is a real test for her: treacherous currents, encounters with dangerous inhabitants of the deep sea and climate change. We will witness the transformation of a small mollusk into a formidable predator that follows its main goal - the preservation of the species. France, 2025

programme.title: d/s Strange creatures of the oceans. When night falls
programme.desc: The depths of the ocean, inaccessible to human gaze, never cease to attract the attention of researchers. Aquatic life, stretching over billions of cubic kilometers, is fraught with a great variety of amazing and strange inhabitants: from giant to miniature, from bright to inconspicuous, from harmless to poisonous, from prey to hunters. Spain, 2024

programme.title: d/s Kalahari: land of secret alliances. Behind the scenes
programme.desc: Follow the scientists who came to the Kalahari to test the hypothesis that animal cooperation is the key to the region's stunning diversity of species

programme.title: Hard working animals. Steppe kestrel and mantis
programme.desc: The prairie kestrel is one of the most effective and impressive pest controllers. Its ability to destroy insects and mice is amazing. Kestrels have another amazing ability. They can hover in the air, scanning the ground below. Having discovered prey, they dive, silently and unnoticed; in this way, kestrels catch dozens of animals every day. Praying mantises live in a wide variety of ecosystems, and no matter where they live, they use the same methods to exterminate local pests. The shape and color of their bodies provide them with camouflage. Spain, 2019, educational

programme.title: Hard working animals. Wolves
programme.desc: Some species of carnivores must rely on teamwork if they want to eat meat. Wolves form packs with a clear hierarchy, this defines the social structure and reinforces the unity and order necessary for the survival of the pack. A striking example of the ability of wolves to work together can be seen in their hunt. The tactics are simple: chase the prey until it gets tired. And if one of the wolves gets tired, the other replaces him. In the end, the combination of resilience and cooperation is rewarded. Spain, 2019, educational

programme.title: Hard working animals. Jackals
programme.desc: The most elegant among the kidnappers are black-backed jackals. They live in Africa and make a living by taking advantage of everything the savannah has to offer. They are often found on the sidelines of banquets hosted by the most powerful inhabitants of the savannas - lions, vultures and hyenas. The black-backed jackal knows how to find the right moment. You need to be patient, judge the distance correctly and be fast. Stealing from a hyena or lion is a dangerous activity: one bite and a slow, painful death. In nature, not all thieves are as cunning and elegant as the black-backed jackal. Some animals look like gangsters. Spain, 2019, educational

programme.title: Hard working animals. 8 p.
programme.desc: There is no life without death, which is why some creatures took on the role of gravediggers. Find out what strange methods they use to make bodies disappear. Spain, 2019, educational

programme.title: d/s Wildlife Science. 3 s.
programme.desc: What is behind the behavior of the most dangerous animals on the planet - lions, sharks, brown bears and rhinoceroses? The series explores their rare behaviors, unexpected hunting strategies, and hidden adaptation mechanisms. Through observation and scientific data, it is revealed how these animals survive in extreme conditions. USA, 2024

programme.title: d/s Wildlife of Singapore. River World

programme.title: d/f Caracals: Society of Lonely Cats
programme.desc: In the savannahs of South Africa, an inexperienced female caracal faces challenges to survival. After several failures, she decides to go on a long journey to the south. On her journey, the predator reaches the suburbs of Cape Town, where her life takes a new turn and she faces the opportunities and threats of a new world.

programme.title: d/s Arsenal of animals. Deadly poison
programme.desc: Animals like frogs, moths, snakes and spiders have venom glands, while stone fish and scorpion fish have poisonous spines. Dir.: Bettina Dalton, Max Serio. USA, Czech Republic, 2016

programme.title: d/f Cayman and the damned swamp
programme.desc: Interesting and tragic stories sometimes happen in nature. The young caiman needs water, but its level is quite low. Now, in order to survive, he needs to adapt to the new reality. But the Pantanal swamps hide various dangers. He will have to fight for his life almost every day

programme.title: d/f Cheetah. From hunter to prey
programme.desc: This program takes us into the world of wildlife, where cheetahs are constantly fighting for survival. We will see their life path from cubs to adults, reveal the peculiarities of daytime hunting and learn how much strength speed takes away, as a result of which other predators often take away the cheetah’s prey. The survival of the fastest beast on Earth involves overcoming many difficulties, and this struggle cannot but inspire admiration. The cheetah is a perfect creature, the fastest land animal among mammals. Of all the representatives of the cat family, this animal is one of the most adapted to life in its habitat, the African savannah. Thanks to its impeccable aerodynamic body structure with an incredibly flexible back, powerful muscles and long legs, the cheetah reaches speeds of over one hundred kilometers per hour in a few seconds! A rather massive tail allows it to change direction with lightning speed in pursuit of ungulates running in zigzags, and an intensely working heart and lungs make it possible to run at top speeds. Spain, 2016

programme.title: d/s Wild Mind. Tools
programme.desc: Animals sometimes demonstrate skills that make you wonder: is this the result of natural instincts or a manifestation of intelligence? They create durable and complex structures, use objects in seemingly unusual ways and find unusual solutions. In this series you will learn how the brains of wild animals work, which helps them survive and adapt. UK, 2022, drama

programme.title: d/f Long-nosed dolphins
programme.desc: Long-nosed dolphins are the most charismatic and elegant inhabitants of the Brazilian archipelago of Fernando de Noronha. These small tropical dolphins are not only called long-nosed dolphins, but also spinners. For their outstanding abilities in the field of aerial acrobatics: these animals can jump to a height of about three meters above the surface of the water and perform up to seven rotations in the air. Longnose Dolphins explores why they need the protective waters of the archipelago, and how fragile that protection can be. Dir.: João Paulo Krajewski. Starring: Rita de Cássia De Carli, Eduardo Cavalcante de Macedo, José Martins da Silva Júnior, Flavio Lima, Marina Consule Tischer. UK, 2016

programme.desc: Winter in the Carpathians challenges the bears. Only half of all boys survive their first year of life. Which strategies ensure their survival? (Station info).

programme.title: Predators of the Carpathians
programme.desc: The Eurasian wolf, which is threatened with extinction, protects the entire ecosystem in the Carpathians. This makes protecting this pack animal with its distinctive sense of smell all the more important. (Station info).

programme.title: The African savannah – a unique habitat
programme.desc: Unheard of behavior: a baboon chases a gazelle, crocodiles eat other animals and a giraffe devours meat. Numerous impressive moments tell of life in the savannah. (Station info).

programme.title: The African savannah – a unique habitat
programme.desc: When predators attack, external events play a role in their success. The direction of the wind, the position of the target and the strategy used by the predators play an important role. (Station info).

programme.title: The African wildlife – life and survival
programme.desc: Its life is determined by drought, predators and rivals ready to fight: a zebra has to learn to assert itself in order to survive. (Station info).

programme.title: The miracle of the return
programme.desc: How do the Earth's internal forces work? What connects people, animals and nature? Questions that the Austrian director Petra Lederhilger investigates. (Station info).

programme.title: Levison Wood: My Journey to...
programme.desc: At the beginning of his journey, adventurer Levison Wood ends up in Borneo, the home of the orangutan. Accompanied by local researchers, he gets up close and personal with the endangered primates. (Station info).

programme.title: Tricksters in the animal kingdom
programme.desc: Squids avoid their predators by adapting their color to their surroundings. Owls that live underground use a different tactic: they imitate the sounds of a rattlesnake. (Station info).

programme.title: Heroes of evolution
programme.desc: From polar bears to sun bears: eight species share a similar body structure but live differently. Behavior and adaptations show exciting similarities. (Station info).

programme.title: Heroes of evolution
programme.desc: Tigers, lions, leopards and jaguars are among the largest cats of prey. With their strength, camouflage and hunting technology, they are feared hunters in Africa, Asia and America. (Station info).

programme.title: Our Earth in Change – The Coral Special
programme.desc: Coral reefs are on the verge of collapse. Researchers around the world are testing new ways to save them: sound experiments, laboratory breeding and artificial reefs give the threatened ecosystem new hope. (Station info).

programme.title: Galapagos
programme.desc: The Pacific archipelago, which belongs to Ecuador, with its isolated animal world, provided evidence for Darwin's theory of the origin of species. To this day, the diversity of the creatures that occur approximately 1000 km from the mainland is fascinating: ancient turtles, marine iguanas, gannets and even sharks that frolic between the approximately 130 volcanic islands. \n\nProducer Jochem van Rijs stimulates thought in two visually stunning parts: “You see how fragile the balance is in a small ecosystem.”

programme.title: Galapagos
programme.desc: Life in the rugged, volcanic landscape of the Galapagos Archipelago presents many challenges. What does the daily struggle of the animal islanders look like? (Station info).

programme.desc: Ngày nay, nền văn minh của loài người trải rộng trên toàn cầu và có hơn 7 tỷ người trên Trái đất. Nhưng loài người đã tiến hóa như thế nào? Có những loại sinh vật giống con người khác không?

programme.title: THE CURSE OF OAK ISLAND S12 EP14
programme.desc: Sau nhiều tháng làm việc không mệt mỏi và tập trung nghiên cứu, cuộc khai quật quy mô lớn để khôi phục Hầm Chappell huyền thoại bắt đầu.

programme.title: THE BERMUDA TRIANGLE: INTO CURSED WATERS S2 EP11
programme.desc: Nhóm cuối cùng có cơ hội giải quyết vụ án USS Cyclops. Mất tích kể từ năm 1918 cùng với 309 thủy thủ, chiếc tàu chở hàng dài 500 feet này là tổn thất nặng nề nhất trong Tam giác quỷ Bermuda.

programme.title: THE PICKERS S26 EP389
programme.desc: Bay một mình, Mike tiến đến ngôi nhà lâu đài ở California của Great Razooly - một nhà điêu khắc, doanh nhân và biểu tượng kinh dị có bộ sưu tập bao gồm quái vật, tượng đầu thú và tàu tên lửa trên bãi cỏ phía trước.

programme.title: ANCIENT ALIENS S15 EP236
programme.desc: Người ngoài hành tinh cổ đại đang đếm ngược mười bức tranh khắc đá về người ngoài hành tinh hàng đầu trên khắp thế giới, từ những hình tượng kỳ lạ giống con người cho đến tàu bay và các bức chạm khắc về những gì có vẻ là phi hành gia.

programme.title: HISTORY'S GREATEST MYSTERIES S4 EP16
programme.desc: Năm 2016, một căn bệnh tấn công hàng chục quan chức chính phủ ở Cuba. Trong vài năm tới, hàng trăm người nữa sẽ phải chịu đau khổ. Nhưng các cuộc điều tra đặt ra nhiều câu hỏi hơn là câu trả lời về dịch bệnh kỳ lạ này.

programme.title: WORLD WAR II WITH TOM HANKS EP03
programme.desc: Chiến dịch Barbarossa, cuộc xâm lược bất ngờ của Đức Quốc xã vào Liên Xô, bắt đầu vào ngày 22 tháng 6 năm 1941. Đây là chiến dịch quân sự lớn nhất trong lịch sử, Hitler nhằm mục đích chiếm đoạt các nguồn lực kinh tế của họ.

programme.title: WORLD WAR II WITH TOM HANKS EP04
programme.desc: Nhật Bản leo thang chiến tranh ở Trung Quốc, thu hút các lệnh trừng phạt ngày càng tăng của Mỹ. Bị thúc đẩy bởi sự thiếu hụt tài nguyên và hệ tư tưởng quân sự, Nhật Bản tấn công Trân Châu Cảng trong một động thái sẽ định hình lại diễn biến của Thế chiến thứ hai.

programme.title: THE MEGA-BRANDS THAT BUILT THE WORLD S3 EP13
programme.desc: Những tên tuổi lớn nhất trong lĩnh vực máy tính đối đầu nhau trong cuộc đua tạo ra những chiếc máy tính di động đầu tiên. Thông qua những thất bại lớn và những liên minh gây sốc, họ sẽ tạo ra thiết bị cầm tay đầu tiên của mình.

programme.title: HISTORY'S DEADLIEST WITH VING RHAMES S1 EP03
programme.desc: Từ những chuyến đi xuyên lục địa và đại dương đến các hoạt động bí mật của CIA, những nhiệm vụ này cho thấy rằng dù có chuẩn bị và lập kế hoạch kỹ lưỡng đến đâu, mọi thứ vẫn có thể trở nên nguy hiểm.

programme.title: THE PICKERS S18 EP326
programme.desc: Robbie say mê với chiếc xe đạp du hành thời gian ở Mississippi trong khi Mike khai quật được một chiếc xe bán tải đời 1932 còn mới ở Bắc Carolina đã không xuất hiện trong 50 năm.

programme.title: THỢ SĂN MÁU: SỰ TRỖI DẬY CỦA QUÁI VẬT LAI - BLOOD HUNTERS: RISE OF THE HYBRI
programme.desc: Gabriella bị thôi thúc bởi sự trả thù sau khi một con quái vật lai tàn sát gia đình cô. Trong nhiệm vụ của mình, cô gia nhập một đội Thợ săn máu và họ cùng nhau tiến hành cuộc chiến chống lại các lãnh chúa tàn nhẫn của thế giới ngầm, gây ra một cuộc đối đầu tàn khốc.

programme.title: CHIẾN BINH THỰC TẾ ẢO - VR FIGHTER
programme.desc: Vệ sĩ Long Wei mắc chứng rối loạn căng thẳng sau chấn thương tâm lý sau cái chết của vợ. Một ngày nọ, anh gặp Amy, người đang làm việc cho một công ty công nghệ VR và được mời dùng thử sản phẩm mới. Sau cuộc thử nghiệm, Long Wei trở thành chiến binh VR của công ty và mặc bộ áo giáp mới được phát minh. Tuy nhiên, khi những người đàn ông có vũ trang bí ẩn đột nhập, một trận chiến khốc liệt vừa mới bắt đầu...

programme.title: BIỆT ĐỘI BÔNG HỒNG THÉP - IRON SQUAD W
programme.desc: Mùa thứ tư của chương trình sinh tồn quân sự Hàn Quốc này sẽ quyết định nữ quân nhân ưu tú nhất. Nó tập hợp sáu đơn vị Lực lượng Đặc biệt để cạnh tranh trong các nhiệm vụ đầy thử thách trên bộ, trên biển và trên không. Những nữ quân nhân dự bị hàng đầu thành lập các đội gồm bốn người để thi đấu với nhau. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ chiến đấu đến cùng trước sáu người dẫn chương trình nổi tiếng!

programme.title: THIẾU NIÊN DIỆP VẤN: THỜI KHẮC NGUY HIỂM - YOUNG IP MAN: CRISIS TIME
programme.desc: Lấy bối cảnh năm 1917, chàng trai trẻ Diệp Vấn theo đuổi việc học ở Hồng Kông. Ngôi trường bị bắt làm con tin vào ngày diễn ra cuộc thi hùng biện tiếng Anh, và khi Diệp Vấn quyết định đứng lên chống lại cuộc khủng hoảng, người ta tiết lộ rằng chủ nhân và người bạn thời thơ ấu của anh đứng đằng sau tất cả những điều này. Liệu anh ta có thể hạ gục họ và bảo vệ công lý?

programme.title: THỬ THÁCH TỘT ĐỘ - EXTREME ENDS
programme.desc: Extreme Ends là một chương trình thực tế phiêu lưu hành động có sự góp mặt của bốn nhân vật nổi tiếng và những vị khách đặc biệt của họ trải nghiệm sự đa dạng của Hồng Kông! Hãy tham gia cùng các người mẫu nổi tiếng Indonesia Patricia và Chika khi họ khám phá những viên ngọc ẩn giấu và khung cảnh sôi động của thành phố, đắm mình trong sự tương phản đáng kinh ngạc và những rung cảm thời thượng.

programme.title: BẠCH PHÁT MA NỮ - BRIDE WITH THE WHITE HAIR
programme.desc: Đệ tử Thiên Sơn Yu Luo Sha thách thức bốn giáo phái lớn và giết chết các thủ lĩnh của họ, làm rung chuyển thế giới võ thuật. Trác Nhất Hàng đối mặt với cô nhưng lại yêu. Khi anh chuẩn bị kết hôn với người khác, cô tóc bạc trắng và thề sẽ không bao giờ gặp lại.
